how do I capture my screen
how do I grab a picture of my screen
how do I take a screen capture
answer: Press **Print Screen** (PrtSc) to open the screenshot tool, then choose an area, a window, or the whole screen and capture — images save to **Pictures/Screenshots**. You can also launch the **Screenshot** app from the Activities overview, and start a screen recording from the same tool. (InterGenOS uses GNOME on Wayland.)
